about_the_game:
Everybody’s favorite golf game series finally returns to the fairway!

Hit the green with a variety of unique characters and courses in online and offline play, and try out new game modes that will have you and your friends scrambling for another round!

• The Classic Gameplay You Love!


The controls are as simple and intuitive as ever. Just aim and press the button 3 times at the right moment to master the perfect shot!

• Hone Your Skills in Single Player Mode


Test the waters with Stroke Play or test your skills by aiming for the gold in over 100 tournaments implemented in Challenge mode.
Take your golf skills to the next level by customizing the rules to your liking by changing the weather and time of day, and face off against a colorful cast of characters!

• Grab Your Friends and Hit the Green


Enjoy local Multiplayer Mode with up to 4 players on a single controller, or test your skills by competing online against golfers worldwide.
For even more excitement, try Wacky Golf - a unique twist on golf that everybody can enjoy together.

Grab your clubs and hit the green with EVERYBODY'S GOLF HOT SHOTS. Let's PAR-TEE!
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows10/Windows11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 980/ Radeon RX Vega 56
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Estimated performance: 1080p/60fps with graphics settings at "Low". Framerate might drop in graphics-intensive scenes.
requirements_recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows10/Windows11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10500 / AMD Ryzen 7 1700
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super/ Radeon RX Vega 64/ Intel Arc A580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Estimated performance: 1080p/60fps with graphics settings at "High". Framerate might drop in graphics-intensive scenes. Windows 10 (Version 1809 or later) and a 4GB VRAM GPU (graphics board or video card) are required for DirectX 12 API.
